components.css: .ds-input{display:block;width:100%;height:2.4rem;padding:0 .75rem;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:1.5rem;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground);font:400 16px Poppins,sans-serif;outline:none;transition:border-color 150ms}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--input) 50%,transparent)}

narrative.northStar: Monochrome clarity for service in motion
narrative.overview: zakkig combines a quiet white working canvas with decisive black actions. The webapp favors fast scanning, clear boundaries, rounded controls, and immediate press feedback. The marketing website applies the same type and color foundation to an editorial composition and a physical QR-paper motif.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces, black text and primary actions, gray containment, and red destructive states.
Poppins for words; Inter with tabular figures for isolated digits and decimal separators.
Pill actions, rounded cards and dialogs, and square QR modules.
Container-responsive work areas, a narrow guest column, and a separate viewport-responsive website.
Borders and tonal layers carry most depth; the website QR paper is a physical exception.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Frontmatter records the shared token layer. Check the linked reference before treating a local override or an intended rule as universal.

rules.name: The Light Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep work areas, forms, dialogs, and guest content light. Reserve black fields for the operational sidebar, primary actions, and the website's dark setup and footer sections.

rules.name: The Semantic Red Rule
rules.body: Use destructive red for errors and destructive actions; use black or gray for ordinary status and selection.

rules.name: The Split Price Rule
rules.body: In the webapp, render UI prices with its Price component: digits and decimal separator take Inter and tabular figures; the currency sign and translated prefix take the surrounding family. The website follows the family separation through its own numeric text pattern.

rules.name: The Endonym Rule
rules.body: Region names use native forms and visible UI copy and destinations are translated with next-intl.

rules.name: The Available Width Rule
rules.body: Use container queries inside dashboard content that can lose space to the sidebar. Use viewport breakpoints for the outer shell and website-wide composition.

rules.name: The Tailwind-First Rule
rules.body: In both apps, especially the webapp, express styling in JSX/TSX with Tailwind utilities whenever that is straightforward. Utilities cover layout, spacing, type, responsive and container queries, state variants, transitions, and interactions; arbitrary values and variants are available for project-specific needs. Reserve custom CSS for shared tokens and fonts, resets, keyframes, and runtime or third-party constraints that utilities cannot express cleanly. Existing custom CSS documents current implementation, not a reason to extend it.

rules.name: The Boundary Rule
rules.body: Prefer a subtle border or tonal fill for normal containment. Visible shadows belong to surfaces with an explicitly floating or physical role.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Preserve a clear inner and outer corner hierarchy. The current popup uses 20px outside and 12px inside with 9.6px padding, which is close to, but not exactly, concentric; the project convention targets outer radius minus padding.

rules.name: The Inline Feedback Rule
rules.body: Inline form errors use left-aligned destructive text; toasts sit top-center. Avoid duplicate inline and toast feedback for one error.

dos: Do keep the main UI light and use black with white text for focal actions.
Do calculate utility dimensions from this project's 0.3rem spacing unit.
Do use Poppins for words and the webapp Price component for prices there.
Do preserve visible focus, disabled, selected, loading, and error states.
Do retain the distinct responsive models of the webapp and website.
Do use Tailwind utilities, including arbitrary values and state or container variants, for expressible styling in both apps.
Do use Phosphor icons and translated UI copy.
donts: Don't treat a zero-opacity theme shadow as visible elevation.
Don't apply the website's 44px CSS button size to the webapp button primitive.
Don't assume stock Tailwind spacing or radius values.
Don't use a dark modal as a general surface pattern.
Don't add redundant globals.css, module CSS, or inline static styles where Tailwind utilities express the same result cleanly.
Don't promote a documented code deviation into a new standard.
